concreteConflict.contract: R1 Trusted source sample step4: unsupported custom workers install no clock authority; only accepted canonical causal L/W/U bracket grants recency

concreteConflict.effect: An accepted injected/cached worker snapshot with structurally valid collectedAt follows the same clock-authority path despite absence of canonical W-capture guarantee. This is a source-level path finding, not a measured native/host exploit.
concreteConflict.alternative: Capture a local immutable clock-provenance capability at Runtime construction; enable it for built-in canonical worker only by default, and withhold clock metadata for arbitrary injected factories. Explicitly reviewed equivalent custom workers/test fixtures can attest the same causal bracket through an owning local mechanism; no Mesh API/wire addition is required.
concreteConflict.requiredEvidence: Owning focused regression: default canonical path still supplies bracket; unsupported injected worker can supply ordinary accepted state but no positive recency/bracket (active branch remains independent); actual accepted-only/superseded sample/history-mirror cases remain correct. Then return one revised immutable candidate.
